s: puM, (aBi GAryyate samantAt vahnO sicyate, aBi + Gf kzaraRe Ric + ac .) GftaM । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥
v: pu॰ aBiGAryyate samantAdagnO sicyate aBi + GfkzaraRe Ric--BAve GaY । agnO samantAt GftAdeH 1 secane 2 GftAdisaMskAraBede ca । “kfdaBihitoBAvo dravyavat prakASate” ityukteH aBiGAryyamARe 3 GftAdO ca niru॰ ।
m: अभि-घार m. sprinkling over, ŚāṅkhGṛ.
scattering over, mingling with, Gobh.
ghee or clarified butter, L.
a: अभिघारः — [घृ-णिच्-भावे घञ्] 1 Ghee or clarified butter. --2 Dropping down ghee upon offerings at sacrifices; प्रणीतपृषदाज्याभिघारघारेस्तनूनपात् Mv. 3.

v: na॰ aBitoGAraRam jalAdiBiH viDinA mecanam । aBi + Gf--Ric--BAve lyuw । GatAdeH saMskAraBede “etya juhvABiGAraRam DruvAyA havipa upaBftaSca” kAtyA॰ 3, 3, 9, “paYcaprayAjahomAnantaraM yajatirasTAnAdetya vedeH paScAdAgatya upaviSya juhUsTenEva prayAjaSezeRa DruvAyA DrOvasyAjyasya havizaH AjyasTAlyAjyapuroqASayoSca upaBftaH upaBftsaMsTasyAjyasya aDvaryuraBiGAraRaM karoti upayogakrameRa ayaYca haviH saMskAraH prayAjaSezapratipattiH havIMzIti dvitIyASruteHhavizaH saMskAryyatvAvagamAt ataH sannihitAni sarvvARi havIMzi SezeRABiGAraRIyAni” karka॰
m: अभि-घारण n. the act of sprinkling ghee, besprinkling, Kauś.; KātyŚr.
a: अभिघारणं — Act of sprinkling (with ghee) besprinkling.

m: अभि-घारित mfn. sprinkled with, AV. &c.
अभि-घार्य mfn. to be sprinkled.

s: [n] puM, (ABimuKyena hanti, aBi + han + Rini .) SatruH । ityamaraH ॥ (vipakzaH ॥ AkramaRakArI । “ekadA na vigfhRIyAt bahUn rAjABiGAtinaH । sadarpo'pyuragaH kIwErbahuBirnaSyati DruvaM” ॥ iti hitopadeSe । pIqAjanakaH । AGAtakArI । “suvyavasTitamantreRa paramarmmABiGAtinA । BavitavyaM narendreRa na kAmavaSavarttinA” । iti rAmAyaRe । pratIkAraH । apasAraRaM .)

puM, (aBi + han + BAve GaY .) daRqAdiBiraBihananaM । AGAtaH । yaTA, -- “aBiGAtABicArAByAmaBizaNgABiSApataH” । iti mADavakaraH ॥ praSnAdO kavargAdivargARAM pUrvvasTitacaturTadvitIyatftIyacaturTavarRAH krameRa parasTitavargEkEkadvitrivarRayuktAH । tatra klI । yaTA -- “aBiGAtaM syAt pUrvvaM vedadvitryabDivarRAScet । nagavargARAM parato DaraRIcandradvirAmAQyAH” ॥ iti keralagranTaH ॥ (prahAraH । aBihananaM । AGAtaH । “caYcadBujaBramitacaRqagadABiGAtasaMcUrRitoruyugalasya suyoDanasya” । iti veRIsaMhAre । saNGarzaRaM । saMmarddaH । pIqanaM । kleSadAnaM । SokakzoBaH । “samBavAMSca viyonIzu duHKaprAyAsu nityaSaH । SItAtapABiGAtAMSca viviDAni BayAni ca” ॥ iti manuH । pratIkAraH । apasAraRaM .)
v: pu॰ aBi + hana--BAve GaY । 1 niHSezahanane samUlanASane “duHKatrayABiGAtAjjijYAsA tadaBiGAtake hetO” sAM॰ kA॰ । 2 tAqane । “taqABiGAtAdiva lagnapaNke” kumA॰ । aBihanyate'smE PalAya uddiSyArTe bA॰ GaY । dravyAntarakriyayA utpAditadravyAntarasaMyoge, vESezikokte SabdahetO, saMyoginormiToviBAgajanakakriyAhetO ca 3 saMyogaBede । yaToktaM “nodanABiGAtAt saMyuktasaMyogAcca pfTivyAM karmmeti vE॰ sU॰ । “yaH saMyogaH SabdanimittakAraRaM, yajjanitaM karmma saMyoginoH parasparaviBAgahetuSca Bavati sa saMyogaviSezo'BiGAtaH nodanaM tu tadvilakzaRaH saMyogaH । tAByAmapri pratyekaM karmma janyate paNkAKyAyAM pfTivyAM caraRena nodanAt caraRABiGAtAcca karmma jAyate tatra paNkaH samavAyikAraRam nodanABiGAtO yaTA yaTamasavAyikAraRam gurutvavegaprayatnA nimittakAraRAni saMyuktasaMyogAt nodanABiGAtAdvA paNke karma paNkasTite GawA dAvapi, tatsamakAlameva karmadarSanAditi” Sa॰ upamkaraH । “AtmasaMyogaprayatnAByAM haste karma, taTA hastasaMyogAcca muzale, aBiGAtaje muzale karmmaRi vyatirekAdakAraRaM hastasaMyogaH” bE॰ sU॰ taTAtmasaMyogAt hastakarmaRi, aBiGAtAnmuzalasaMyogAcca haste karma “AtmajanyA BavedicCA icCAjanyA Bavet kftiH kftijanyA BaveccezwA cezwAjanyA Bavet kriye” tyuktimamusftyAha AtsasaMyogaprayatnAByAM hastesamavATikAraRe karma, tasya ca karmaRaH prayatnavadAtmasaMyogo'samavAyi kAraRaM prayatnastu nimittakAraRam prayatnavadAtmasaMyogAsamavAyi kAraRikA ca kriyEva cezwA । taTA utkzepabadDastasaMyogAt muzale utkzepaRaM karma jAyate । taTAca prayatnavadAtmasaMyuktena hastena yo muzalasya saMyogaH sa tatrAsamAyikAraRam muzalaM samavAyikAraRamiti । udUKalABihatasya muzalasya karmayadutpapatanaM jAyate tatra kAraRamAha । muzalAdO utpatana karmaRi aBiGAta eva hetuH, na tu hastasaMyogaH tasya taM prati kAraRatvenAnyayAsidDatvAt tadvyatireke'pi aBiGAtamAtreRa aBihatapraDAnagurudravya saMyogenEva utpatanadarSanAt yaTA BUmyAdO hastena vegakziptalozwAderhastayogaM vinA'pi utpatti rdfSyate'ta utpatane aBiGAta eva asamanAyikAraRam “aBiGAtAt muzale saMyogAdDaste karma” vE॰ sU॰ aBiGAtAt aBiGAtajanitasaMskArajanitAt hastamuzalasaMyogAt haste utpatanaM karma tatra muzalasaMyogo'samAyikAraRam । tIvravegaprayuktakriyAjanitaH saMyogaH SabdahetuH । “tftIyaH syAt karmmajo'pi dviDEva parikIrttitaH aBiGAtonodanaYca SabdaheturihAdimaH । SabdAheturdvitIyaH syAditi” “SabdoDvaniSca varRRaSca mfdaNgAdiBavoDvaniH । “kaRWasaMyogAdijanyAvarRRAste kAdayomatA” iti ca BAzA॰ ataevoktam “kaRWatAlvAdyaBiGAtajanyaH SabdaH” iti vfdDEH । SikzAyAmapyuktam “AtmA budDyA sametyArTAn manoyuNkte vivakzayA । manaH kAmAgnimAhanti sa prerayati mArutam । so dIrRRo mUrdDnyaBihato vaktramApadya mArutaH varRRAn janayate” iti । sa udIrRaH sanDiH pAdapUraRArTaH । mfdaNgAdO tIvravegena kAzWAditAqanasaMyoge Sabdojanyate iti lOke prasidDiH । vfkzAdO pravalataravAyusaMyogAccaSabdo DvanyAtmaka eva । mfduvegena kriyayA saMyoge nodanarUpe na SabdaH iti tasyaM SabdAhetutvamuktam aDikaM nodanaSabde vakzyate । “aBiGAto'styasya arSa॰ ac । aBiGAtayukte tri॰ “aBiGAtaM syAt pUrvvaM vedadvitryadivarRAyet । navavargARAM navato DaraRIcandradvirAmAdyA” iti keralokte varRaBede, na॰ SabdakalpadrumaH ।
m: अभि-घात m. (√ हन्), striking, attack
infliction of injury, damage, Mn. xii, 77, &c.
striking back, driving away, warding off
abrupt or vehement articulation (of Vedic text), VPrāt.

अभि-घात n. an irregular combination of consonants i.e. the combination of the fourth letter of gutturals, cerebrals, &c. with the first or third letter, of the second with the first letter, and of the third with the second letter of those classes of consonants.
अभि-घात See s.v.
a: अभिघातः — 1 Striking, (fig. also); beating, smiting, attack, injury, hurt; तटाभिघातादिव लग्नपंके Ku. 7. 49; शीतातपाभिघातान् Ms. 12. 77 attacks of heat and cold; so दुःख˚, शोक˚ &c. --2 (In Vaiśeṣika phil.) Striking against (such as gives rise to sounds &c.), regarded as a kind of संयोग. --3 Striking back, driving or warding off. --4 Extirpation, complete destruction or removal; दुःखत्रयाभिघाताज्जिज्ञासा तदभिघातके हेतौ Sāṅ. K. 1. --5 Abrupt or vehement articulation of words (as of Vedic texts); sudden shock. --तं 1 The combination of the 4th letter of any class with the first or third letter of that class; of the second with the first; and of the third with the second letter of any class; अभिघातं स्यात्पूर्वं वेदद्वित्र्यादिवर्णाश्चेत् . नववर्गाणां नवतो धरणीचंद्रद्विरामाद्याः Śabdak. --2 A harsh pronunciation caused by the neglect of Saṃdhi rules.

v: tri॰ aBi + hana--Rvul । 1 SatrO ripO 2 aBiGAtasaMyogakArake 3 samUlanASake ca । “tadaBiGAtake hetO” sAM॰ kA॰ ।
m: अभि-घातक mf(इका)n. counteracting, removing.
a: अभिघातक — a. Striking; keeping or beating back, repelling, extirpating. --कः An enemy.

v: tri॰ aBi + hana--Rini striyAM NIp । 1 SatrO 2 nASake 3 aBiGAtasaMyogakArake ca ।
m: अभि-घातिन् mfn. (generally ifc.) striking, attacking, hurting
inflicting injury
अभि-घातिन् m. an assailant, enemy, Hit.
a: अभिघातिन् — Striking, hurting. --m. An enemy; assailant.

m: अभि-घातित mfn. struck, wounded (ifc. as शराभिघातित, wounded by arrows).
अभि-घातित See s.v.

v: na॰ aBi + Gfza--BAve lyuw । parasparasaMyogena 1 GarzaRe, 2 marddane ca ।
m: अभि-घर्षण n. (√ घृष्), rubbing, friction, L.
possession by an evil spirit, L.
a: अभिघर्षणं — 1 Rubbing, friction. --2 Possession by an evil spirit.

m: अभि-√ घृ (perf. Pass. p. अभि-घृत See below). Caus. -घारयति, to cause to trickle down, TS. &c.; to sprinkle with, ŚBr. &c.
a: अभिघृ — (Used only in caus.). 1 To cause to trickle down, let fall down by drops; तां (वपां) अध्वर्युः स्रुवेणाभिघारयन्नाह Ait. Br. --2 To sprinkle with.

m: अभि-घृत mfn. sprinkled (as ghee), dropped upon, TS.
sprinkled with, BhP.
अभि-घोषम् ind. towards a station of herdsmen, Kir.
अभि-√ घ्रा -जिघ्रति (ind.p. -जिघ्र्य, Gobh.) to snuffle, smell at; to bring the nose close to another's forehead in caressing, or as a token of affection, TS. &c.; to smell, scent, Kād.
a: अभिघ्रा — {c1c} P. To smell at, snuffle; to bring the nose close to another's forehead (as in caressing, kissing &c. as a token of affection).

m: अभि-घ्राण n. smelling at, caressing Comm. on Gobh.
a: अभिघ्राणं — Smelling at or touching the forehead with the nose.
